subject: Service outage Oct 5, 2026 — compensation & trial extension request
body_preview: Thanks for flagging — we investigated, propose a one-time credit + trial extension; draft attached, please confirm acceptance via DocuSign.
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@fastretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fastretail.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production errors Oct 5 (30% errors window) — request for remediation/credits

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

We saw a significant production regression this morning between ~08:40–09:25 UTC (our metrics show a spike of 503s and timeouts that impacted 30% of requests for that window). This affected checkout flows for several of our regions and resulted in ~45 minutes of degraded service for our customers.

Our SREs captured traces and a rough estimate of lost revenue for that period. Can you advise what happened on your side and whether Redwood can provide a remediation package (credits, trial extension, or token top-up) while we investigate downstream impacts? We’ll attach the high-level impact spreadsheet after I double-check numbers.

Thanks — we’re trying to get a clear statement for our execs this afternoon.

—Daniel
Daniel Cho
Head of Infrastructure, FastRetail
ops@fastretail.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors Oct 5 (30% errors window) — request for remediation/credits

Hi Daniel — thanks for the note and very sorry for the disruption. I’ve escalated to our incident team and we’re pulling the telemetry now.

Immediate next steps:
- I’ll send a short preliminary statement within the hour confirming the timeline on our side.
- Can you send the SPAN/trace ids or the top-line impact numbers (estimated revenue impact / peak error rate) so we can align amounts?
- I’m looping in Hannah and Aditya to get a proposed remediation package (credits + trial extension) ready for you this afternoon.

We treat incidents like this seriously — we’ll propose a clear, measurable remedy and a simple acceptance path (DocuSign or email confirmation) so you can close this out with your execs.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: suggested remediation numbers for FastRetail outage

Internal — I’ve pulled the incident telemetry and matched it to SLAs. Summary:
- Incident window (Redwood observed): 08:38–09:20 UTC (approx. 42 minutes) with elevated 5xx rate.
- Affected routes: /v1/generate (checkout model path), ~28% error-rate spike.
- Customer production throttling and retry churn are visible in traces.

Suggested remediation:
1) One-time service credit equivalent to a $12,000 token/top-up (covers estimated overage and goodwill).
2) 14-day trial/usage extension for their pilot customers (adds runway for any backfills).
3) Immediate provisional credit applied to their account while finance does a final sign-off — we can reverse if there is a later dispute.

Attachments: incident_telemetry_20261005.csv (contains sample traces + aggregated metrics).

Rationale: 12k is a quick math based on minutes impacted, average token consumption, and goodwill norms — it’s conservative but meaningful. If we need to tighten for faster approval, $10k would clear SOC/finance faster.

—Hannah
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: suggested remediation numbers for FastRetail outage

Team — I agree with Hannah’s assessment. To keep momentum with the customer and get a fast acceptance from their execs, propose we:
- Offer a provisional $10,000 credit immediately (applied to invoices now).
- Add a 14-day trial extension and a 50,000-token promotional top-up.
- Prepare a short remedy statement (one-page) and a DocuSign link for acceptance.

Finance/legal will need to sign off on the final language; Marissa, can you prepare the remedy_statement_fastretail.pdf and route to legal? If legal needs the $12k ask we had planned, we can escalate — but I prefer $10k for faster closure.

If we can get provisional credit applied before EOD PST, I’ll message the customer directly with the DocuSign so they have an immediate remediation to present.

Thanks —Aditya
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood proposed remediation for Oct 5 incident — FastRetail

Hi Daniel — thanks again for your patience while we investigated. Attached is a short remedy statement that summarizes the incident and the proposed remediation. In brief we are offering: 

- A provisional $10,000 service credit applied to your account immediately (visible on next invoice).
- A 14-day trial/usage extension for your pilot workloads.
- A one-time 50,000-token promotional top-up to help smooth any retries during recovery.

Action items:
- We’ve attached the remedy_statement_fastretail.pdf. If that looks good, please sign via the DocuSign link below and the provisional credit will remain in place. If you prefer, email acceptance is also fine.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/FR-accept-20261006
Attachment: remedy_statement_fastretail.pdf
Attachment: incident_telemetry_20261005.csv

We hope this helps close the loop quickly — we’ll also schedule a short post-incident call to walk through root cause and steps we’re taking to prevent recurrence.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@fastretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fastretail.com
Date: 2026-10-06T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposed remediation for Oct 5 incident — FastRetail

On Wed, Oct 6, 2026 at 3:34 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Daniel — thanks again for your patience while we investigated. Attached is a short remedy statement that summarizes the incident and the proposed remediation...

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the quick follow-up and the provisional credit. I reviewed the remedy statement and signed via DocuSign just now (link worked fine). We’ll take the 14-day extension and the token top-up — that should be enough to stabilize our pilot while we finish postmortem work.

Please schedule the post-incident call; I’ll bring one of our SREs and the product lead.

—Daniel
